dc:title: google maps language changes
dc:description: Historical secondary compilation and deterministic geometry of printed intervals; no individual reviews, Canadian sample or significance tests.

columns.name: point_change_pp
columns.dc:description: 2025H1 minus 2024H2 published point estimate; not an estimated causal effect.

columns.name: reported_interval_relation
columns.dc:description: Closed intervals formed from printed endpoints: positive-width intersection, touching endpoint, or separated. Not a significance/equivalence test.

columns.name: signed_shared_width_pp
columns.dc:description: min(upper endpoints) minus max(lower endpoints), in percentage points. Negative means separated; zero means touching at printed precision.

columns.name: record_type
columns.dc:description: Distinguishes source estimates from derived comparisons; derived rows are not additional observations.
